ifynwbcjkqJ-AGIl9IpV6w.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至9/28,累計47個州/地區報告3,659例確定病例、2例死亡,95%病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明,以5-19歲(1,577例)佔43%為多,其中以賓州(850例)、南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(535例)等地為主。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至9/28,累計報告13,484例確定病例、22例死亡,其中以哈利斯科州(Jalisco)7,266例為多、其次為首都墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,033例;年齡分佈以1-4歲2,692例為多,其次為5-9歲(2,398例)及25-29歲(2,234例)。 秘魯今年截至9/25,累計報告2,438例確定病例,1例死亡,為洛雷托大區(Loreto)16歲未接種疫苗男孩,因麻疹併發症(包括肺炎)死亡。由於該區地理偏遠、交通不便等因素,致疫苗接種、病例追蹤與醫療服務等,面臨挑戰。
ifynwbcjkqJ-AGIl9IpV6w.en: US measles cases continue to rise. As of 28 September this year, 3,659 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported across 47 states/jurisdictions; 95% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history, and ages 5–19 (1,577 cases, 43%) accounted for the largest share. The largest numbers are in Pennsylvania (850), South Carolina (670) and Utah (535). Mexico's epidemic continues: as of 28 September this year, 13,484 confirmed cases and 22 deaths have been reported, with Jalisco (7,266 cases) having the most, followed by the capital, Mexico City (1,033 cases). By age, the largest numbers were among those aged 1–4 (2,692), followed by 5–9 years (2,398) and 25–29 years (2,234). As of 25 September this year, Peru has reported 2,438 confirmed cases and one death: a 16-year-old unvaccinated boy in the Loreto region who died of measles complications, including pneumonia. Because the region is geographically remote and hard to reach, vaccination, case tracing and healthcare services face challenges.

d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.zh: 歐盟今年7月共計13國報告118例確定病例,以保加利亞(61 例)、義大利(29例)、西班牙(7例)、波蘭(7例)及比利時(4例)為多。近12個月(2025/8/1-2026/7/31)共計30國報告2,339例病例,其中2,012例(86.0%)經實驗室確診。個案集中於15歲(含)以上(51.2%)。ECDC評估疫情主因為部分國家疫苗覆蓋率不足、境外移入等因素,並呼籲各國提升疫苗覆蓋率至95%以上。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至9/5(第35週),計17個國家/地區累計報告52,676例確定病例及61例死亡(CFR:0.12%),較去年同期病例數增加約3.8倍。有99.5%的病例集中於瓜地馬拉(33,334 例)、墨西哥(12,848例)、美國(3,134例)、秘魯(1,997例)及加拿大(1,119例);泛美衛生組織(PAHO)預計今年11月進行評估墨西哥消除麻疹認證。
d14HJLgUrMu7aAlZBkLaUA.en: In July this year, 13 EU countries reported a total of 118 confirmed cases, mainly Bulgaria (61), Italy (29), Spain (7), Poland (7) and Belgium (4). Over the past 12 months (1 August 2025–31 July 2026), 30 countries reported 2,339 cases, of which 2,012 (86.0%) were laboratory-confirmed. Cases are concentrated among people aged 15 and over (51.2%). The ECDC attributes the outbreaks mainly to insufficient vaccination coverage in some countries and imported cases, and calls on countries to raise vaccination coverage to above 95%. In the Americas, as of 5 September this year (week 35), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 52,676 confirmed cases and 61 deaths (CFR 0.12%), about 3.8 times the number in the same period last year. Some 99.5% of cases were concentrated in Guatemala (33,334), Mexico (12,848), the United States (3,134), Peru (1,997) and Canada (1,119). PAHO plans to assess Mexico's measles elimination certification in November this year.

QkWx_T6ZifDX1nNOfpTTGw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/22(第33週),計17個國家/地區累計報告51,027例確定病例及55例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4.6倍,96%病例來自瓜地馬拉(32,566例)、墨西哥(12,607例)、美國(2,777例)及加拿大(1,117例)。
QkWx_T6ZifDX1nNOfpTTGw.en: Americas regional update: as of 22 August this year (week 33), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 51,027 confirmed cases and 55 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about 4.6 times the number in the same period last year. 96% of cases came from Guatemala (32,566), Mexico (12,607), the United States (2,777) and Canada (1,117).

lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.zh: 南非今年截至8/16(第33週),累計報告3,891例確定病例,較上週增加144例,1-14歲兒童佔總病例數之70%,新增病例以西開普省38例為多,其次為林波波省30例及北開普省20例;疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為主要因素,1歲以下未接種疫苗比例從2017年12.1%上升至2026年36.3%,該國優先針對未接種疫苗或尚未完整接種之兒童進行補接種作業。 秘魯今年截至第33週報告1,747例確定病例,其中以普諾地區(1,264例)為多,由於病例數增加,該國衛生部發佈流行病學警報,針對醫療機構加強流行病學監測及早期發現,並在受影響地區採取防治措施。 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至8/8(第31週),計17個國家/地區累積報告48,690例確定病例及51例死亡(CFR:0.10%),較去年同期病例數增加約4倍,97%病例來自瓜地馬拉(31,140例)、墨西哥(12,479例)、美國(2,465例)及加拿大(1,114例),部分國家通報延遲,研判疫情可能低估。
lffYidjRiGEcjH1J9dxY1g.en: South Africa: as of 16 August this year (week 33), 3,891 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, an increase of 144 over the previous week; children aged 1–14 account for 70% of total cases. The largest numbers of new cases are in Western Cape (38), followed by Limpopo (30) and Northern Cape (20). Insufficient vaccination coverage is the main factor: the proportion of unvaccinated children under 1 year old rose from 12.1% in 2017 to 36.3% in 2026. The country is prioritising catch-up vaccination for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children. Peru: as of week 33 this year, 1,747 confirmed cases have been reported, mainly in the Puno region (1,264 cases). Because case numbers are rising, the Ministry of Health has issued an epidemiological alert, strengthening surveillance and early detection in healthcare facilities and taking control measures in affected areas. Americas regional update: as of 8 August this year (week 31), 17 countries and territories had cumulatively reported 48,690 confirmed cases and 51 deaths (CFR 0.10%), about four times the number in the same period last year; 97% of cases came from Guatemala (31,140), Mexico (12,479), the United States (2,465) and Canada (1,114). Because some countries reported with delays, the outbreak is likely underestimated.

B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.zh: 孟加拉疫情持續擴大,今年截至8/11,累計報告近14萬例病例其中17,385例確定病例及880例死亡(98例確定),所有行政區皆有病例,主要集中於首都達卡(Dhaka Division;60,866例、404例死亡),較為嚴重,其次為吉大港(Chattogram)及巴里薩爾(Barishal),當局持續擴大疫苗接種活動。 美洲區今年截至7月中旬,累積4,7459例確定病例,44例死亡,今年累積確定病例數相較去年同期5,123例增加8倍,且為自2004年以來確定病例數最多之一年,病例數以瓜地馬拉、墨西哥、美國及祕魯最為嚴峻,合計占該洲病例數95%,另以20-29 歲年齡組病例比例最高(31%)。 美國今年截至8/13累積報告2,566例(含16例境外移入),約19% 為5歲(含)以下兒童,67%為青少年,7%患者需住院治療。主要集中於南卡羅萊納州(670例)及猶他州(526例);賓州為目前疫情熱區,8/17當週新增60例確定病例,迄今累計307例。另93%病患為未接種疫苗或疫苗接種史不明。 瑞典今年截至8/17報告10例疑病例,可能與7/31至8/1辦理之音樂節相關,多數病例為18歲以下兒童;該國已啟動接觸者追蹤與跨國通報,並持續監測相關疫情。
B-0-ZQAXkOClaPJMSuEhvA.en: Bangladesh's epidemic continues to expand. As of 11 August this year, nearly 140,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17,385 confirmed cases and 880 deaths (98 of them confirmed). Cases have been reported in all administrative areas and are concentrated mainly in the capital, Dhaka Division (60,866 cases, 404 deaths), followed by Chattogram and Barishal; authorities continue to expand vaccination activities. In the Americas, as of mid-July this year, 47,459 confirmed cases and 44 deaths had been reported cumulatively. Confirmed cases this year are 8 times the 5,123 in the same period last year, making this one of the years with the highest number of confirmed cases since 2004. Cases are most severe in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States and Peru, which together account for 95% of the region's cases; the 20–29 age group has the highest proportion (31%). In the United States, as of 13 August this year, 2,566 cases (including 16 imported) have been reported cumulatively; about 19% were children aged 5 and under, 67% were adolescents, and 7% of patients required hospitalisation. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina (670) and Utah (526). Pennsylvania is currently the hotspot, with 60 confirmed cases added in the week of 17 August and 307 cumulatively to date. In addition, 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Sweden reported 10 suspected cases as of 17 August this year, possibly linked to a music festival held on 31 July–1 August; most were children under 18. The country has initiated contact tracing and cross-border notification and continues to monitor the related outbreak.

SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.zh: 巴布亞紐幾內亞衛生部於今年7/7宣佈爆發疫情,該國8個省份自今年1月以來累計報告108例疑個案(含3例確定病例),由於該國實驗室檢驗量能不足,須送往澳洲進行檢驗,可能低估實際傳播情形。另病例地理分佈無流行病學關聯,且該國疫苗覆蓋率低,預期疫情擴散。 巴西今年截至7/31,累計報告18例確定病例,主要集中於首都聖保羅(15例)之2歲以下與20-50歲族群。此波疫情為該國獲得消除麻疹認證後,首次出現持續性本土傳播,主因為該地區為重要樞紐,且近期世界盃結束後人潮返國及7至8月學校假期等因素。該國已針對特定地區擴大疫苗接種對象為6個月至59歲族群,防止疫情向外擴散。 美洲地區疫情持續,自今年截至7/25,共17國/地區累計報告4 萬7,026例確定病例及48例死亡(CFR:0.10%),病例數較去年同期增加5倍。其中,高達97%確定病例集中於瓜地馬拉(30,040例)、墨西哥(12,233例)、美國(2,318例)及加拿大(1,107 例)。
SrZaQQj5mzmfT7JyDIYI0A.en: Papua New Guinea's Ministry of Health declared an outbreak on 7 July this year. Across 8 provinces, 108 suspected cases (including 3 confirmed) have been reported since January this year. Because the country's laboratory testing capacity is limited, samples must be sent to Australia for testing, which may underestimate the actual spread. In addition, cases are geographically dispersed with no epidemiological links, and vaccination coverage is low, so the outbreak is expected to spread. As of 31 July this year, Brazil has reported 18 confirmed measles cases, mainly in the city of São Paulo (15 cases), among children under 2 years and people aged 20 to 50 years. This is the first sustained local transmission since the country was certified as having eliminated measles. The main factors are that the area is an important hub, the return of travellers after the recently concluded World Cup, and school holidays in July and August. Brazil has expanded vaccination in specific areas to people aged 6 months to 59 years to prevent the outbreak from spreading further. Measles activity in the Region of the Americas continues. As of 25 July this year, 17 countries and territories have reported a cumulative 47,026 confirmed cases and 48 deaths (CFR: 0.10%), a five-fold increase over the same period last year. As many as 97% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Guatemala (30,040), Mexico (12,233), the United States (2,318) and Canada (1,107).

JCG5Z-gSaS0Vx3DyMo-DSQ.zh: 美國今年截至7/23,累計2,318例確定病例,已超越去年全年2,289例,19歲以下族群達1,581例,其中有10%之5歲以下兒童住院,且高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。賓州迄7/27,過去7天新增報告31例確定病例,累計142例確定病例,為近期疫情上升地區之一。該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至7/24,累計報告12,335例確定病例,18例死亡,超越去年全年6,614例。其中以西部哈利斯科州(Jalisco)6,611例為多,墨西哥城(Ciudad de México)1,012例次之。確診人數以1-9歲孩童(4,753例)及25-29歲年輕成人(2,154 例)為好發族群。 哈薩克巴甫洛達爾州(Pavlodar)疫情上升,今年上半年已累積報告398例確定病例,有345例(87%)未接種疫苗,其中288例為14歲以下兒童。該國指出疫苗接種覆蓋率不足為此次爆發疫情的主要原因,該國已加強疫苗接種,並針對拒絕接種疫苗之家庭加強溝通。 瓜地馬拉(Guatemala)今年截至7/24,累計報告30,040例確定病例,29例死亡(CFR:0.1%) ,約10%個案住院,另15至39歲族群佔確定病例63%,1歲以下為高風險族群。
JCG5Z-gSaS0Vx3DyMo-DSQ.en: The United States has reported 2,318 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 23 July, exceeding last year's full-year total of 2,289. Cases aged under 19 years total 1,581, and 10% of children under 5 years have been hospitalized. As many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Pennsylvania reported 31 new confirmed cases in the 7 days to 27 July, bringing its cumulative total to 142 confirmed cases, and it is one of the areas where the outbreak has recently increased. The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. Mexico's outbreak continues. As of 24 July this year, 12,335 confirmed cases and 18 deaths have been reported cumulatively, exceeding last year's total of 6,614. Jalisco State accounts for most cases (6,611), followed by Mexico City (1,012). Children aged 1 to 9 years (4,753 cases) and young adults aged 25 to 29 years (2,154 cases) are the most affected groups. In Pavlodar Region of Kazakhstan, cases are rising. In the first half of this year, 398 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 345 (87%) were unvaccinated, including 288 children aged under 14 years. The country identifies insufficient vaccination coverage as the main cause of this outbreak, has strengthened vaccination, and has enhanced communication with families who refuse vaccination. Guatemala has reported 30,040 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 24 July, including 29 deaths (CFR: 0.1%). About 10% of cases were hospitalized. People aged 15 to 39 years account for 63% of confirmed cases, and infants under 1 year are a high-risk group.

SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.zh: 尚比亞疫情上升,今年1月至7月3日,全國累計報告700例疑個案(含119例確定病例與4例死亡)。目前全國10個省中已有9個省份出現確定病例,其中以西部省(Western Province)最為嚴峻。高達87.4%的確定病例無疫苗接種紀錄,當局預計於7/6-11 在5個高風險地區,針對6個月至9歲兒童展開緊急疫苗接種。 瓜地馬拉疫情嚴峻且範圍持續擴大,今年截至7/5,全國累計報告逾2萬5,700例病例,其中7,260例經實驗室確診,並有24例死亡。此波疫情源自去(114)年12月的大型宗教集會,首例個案於今(115)年1/9確診。自6月中旬迄今之3週內,快速新增近9,000 例確定病例,當局正擴大疫苗接種計畫中。 美洲地區麻疹疫情嚴峻。自今年初迄6/27止,共17國累計報告逾2萬2,900例確定病例及39例死亡,較去年同期遽增181%。逾96%確定病例集中於墨西哥(11,820例)、瓜地馬拉(7,067例)、美國(2,134例)及加拿大(1,079例)。近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第23至24週病例報告數較前2週下降51.1%,主要為墨西哥、秘魯及美國病例減少;加拿大則處於疫情低點;另瓜地馬拉恐有通報延遲情形,須謹慎解讀該國疫情趨勢。
SxDoTJa8ggj5Mad7MwieHg.en: Measles is rising in Zambia. From January to 3 July this year, 700 suspected cases have been reported nationally, including 119 confirmed cases and 4 deaths. Confirmed cases have now been identified in 9 of the country's 10 provinces, with the most severe situation in Western Province. As many as 87.4% of confirmed cases had no vaccination record. Authorities plan to carry out emergency vaccination for children aged 6 months to 9 years in 5 high-risk districts from 6 to 11 July. Guatemala's outbreak is severe and continues to expand. As of 5 July this year, more than 25,700 cases have been reported nationally, of which 7,260 were laboratory-confirmed, and 24 deaths have occurred. This wave originated from a large religious gathering in December 2025, and the first case was confirmed on 9 January 2026. In the three weeks since mid-June, nearly 9,000 confirmed cases have been added rapidly, and authorities are expanding the vaccination programme. The measles outbreak in the Region of the Americas is severe. From the start of this year to 27 June, 17 countries have reported more than 22,900 confirmed cases and 39 deaths cumulatively, a sharp 181% increase over the same period last year. More than 96% of confirmed cases are concentrated in Mexico (11,820), Guatemala (7,067), the United States (2,134) and Canada (1,079). The recent trend is declining: case reports in weeks 23–24 were 51.1% lower than in the previous two weeks, mainly because of fewer cases in Mexico, Peru and the United States. Canada is at a low point. Guatemala may have reporting delays, so its trend should be interpreted with caution.

Zv47-rf4Br5XvH06ckqdwQ.zh: 世界盃足球賽(FIFA) 主辦國疫情持續,  墨西哥自6/18-22新增55例確定病例。自2025年至2026/6/22止,已累計報告1萬8,440例確定病例,並導致11個州共43人死亡,其中西部哈里斯科州累計報告6,517例確定病例,為全國最高;而首都墨西哥城則累計達993例確定病例。 美國加州截至6/12報告50例確定病例,為去年度總數之兩倍,亦創下2019年以來新高。 加拿大截至6/22累計報告1,073例確定病例,專家表示頻繁的賽事跨國移動及墨國的本土疫情,疫情可能持續擴散。
Zv47-rf4Br5XvH06ckqdwQ.en: The outbreak continues in the host countries of the FIFA World Cup. Mexico reported 55 confirmed cases between 18 and 22 June. From 2025 through 22 June 2026, 18,440 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, causing 43 deaths across 11 states. Jalisco State in the west has the highest cumulative total, with 6,517 confirmed cases, while the capital, Mexico City, has reached 993 confirmed cases cumulatively. California, United States, reported 50 confirmed cases as of 12 June, twice last year's total and the highest since 2019. Canada reported 1,073 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 22 June. Experts say frequent cross-border movement during the tournament, together with the local outbreak in Mexico, may allow the outbreak to continue spreading.

fw7XnYqO5xXj4vpOOG2wMw.zh: 美國加州南洛杉磯郡5/23公布1起群聚疫情,病例數仍調查中,病患皆食用從墨西哥銷入的未殺菌起司。該郡過往每年報告低於15例病例,多與食用未殺菌起司、職業或實驗室暴露有關,當局呼籲民眾避免食用生食或未經殺菌的乳製品。
fw7XnYqO5xXj4vpOOG2wMw.en: On 23 May, Southern Los Angeles County, California, United States, announced a cluster; case numbers are still under investigation. All patients ate unpasteurised cheese sold after being shipped from Mexico. In past years the county has reported fewer than 15 cases a year, mostly linked to eating unpasteurised cheese or to occupational or laboratory exposure. Authorities urge the public to avoid eating raw or unpasteurised dairy products.

fDj48FwAISQbs1MyTOdAuQ.zh: 宏都拉斯於5/21報告首例病例,該案為40歲男性,經研判為自鄰國瓜地馬拉境外移入案例。瓜地馬拉自2025年12月截至5/13累計報告6,209例確診病例、7,752例極可能病例及12例死亡,該國已發布紅色疫情警戒,本事件顯示瓜地馬拉疫情持續擴大,已出現跨國傳播案例。 墨西哥今年截至5/22累計報告1萬1,033例病例,病患分布以哈利斯科州及墨西哥市為多。自2025年1月起,此波疫情累計報告1萬7,641例病例及41例死亡,病患年層以1-4歲占大宗,其次為5-9歲。
fDj48FwAISQbs1MyTOdAuQ.en: Honduras reported its first case on 21 May: a 40-year-old man, assessed as an imported case from neighbouring Guatemala. From December 2025 through 13 May, Guatemala reported 6,209 confirmed cases, 7,752 probable cases and 12 deaths cumulatively. The country has issued a red alert for the outbreak. This event shows that the outbreak in Guatemala continues to expand and has produced cross-border transmission. Mexico reported 11,033 cases this year as of 22 May, mainly in Jalisco State and Mexico City. Since January 2025, this wave of the outbreak has recorded 17,641 cases and 41 deaths cumulatively, with children aged 1–4 accounting for the largest share, followed by those aged 5–9.

V1xuQdREiddNmKqJq9U2Aw.en: Brazil has reported more than 38,000 cases and 15 deaths so far this year, including more than 2,000 confirmed cases and 10 deaths cumulatively in the western state of Mato Grosso do Sul. Costa Rica reported its third case this year, a 45-year-old foreign national man residing in Guanacaste Province in the northwest of the country. Epidemiological investigation shows he entered the country during the incubation period, making it an imported case. In Catarina, San Marcos Department in the southwest of Guatemala, one confirmed case was reported at the end of February; the neighbouring Mexican state of Chiapas has also reported cases this year. Guatemala has also reported four suspected cases in Escuintla, Chiquimula and Guatemala departments. Given continued rises in case numbers across the Americas, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) continues to issue epidemiological alerts.

0Prn-huek3RoQn7KebiVWA.en: Japan's outbreak update: as of 1 April this year, 197 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 28 were imported. Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (48 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (24), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa Prefecture (19) reported the most. Japan reported 265 confirmed cases last year. Bangladesh's outbreak is rising: as of March this year, 722 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 514 were reported in March alone; 57% of cases were infants under 6 months old. Since mid-March, more than 7,600 suspected cases have been reported, and more than 113 deaths were reported over the past six weeks. Authorities have launched emergency vaccination for more than 1.3 million children aged 6 months to under 5 years in 30 high-risk areas. The outbreak in the Americas continues: as of 6 April this year, Mexico has reported 8,750 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 9 deaths, with most cases in western Jalisco State (5,062 cases). As of 2 April this year, the United States has reported 1,671 confirmed cases across 33 states, and the outbreak in Utah has recently risen. As of 21 March this year, Canada has reported 650 confirmed cases, mainly in Manitoba (392 cases) and Alberta (209 cases). Guatemala's outbreak is rising: as of 29 March this year, 3,594 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 22 departments, with 54% concentrated in Guatemala Department in the central-south. During Holy Week, religious activities and travel increased, and case numbers are expected to continue rising.

xrr80roC5ErMIg5Y4gLi1Q.en: The WHO Americas Region has updated its epidemiological report. The region reported 46,870 confirmed cases last year, lower than the 66,184 reported in the same period of 2024. The United States reported the most, with 28,783 confirmed (including suspected) cases, mainly among people aged 11–19 years. Peru followed with 4,632 cases, and Chile (3,387), Brazil (2,682), Mexico (1,596), Argentina (1,210) and Colombia (1,178) each also reported more than 1,000 confirmed cases. In addition, the United States had reported 2,355 confirmed cases so far this year as of 27 March.

bwqTFzmmAF2Om7WPLWdN_g.zh: 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至3/23共32州累計報告3,422例確定病例,主要分布於西北部下加利福亞、東部維拉克魯茲、南部恰帕斯州、東北部新雷昂及塔毛利帕斯州,專家表示該國邊境人口遷移及COVID-19大流行後疫苗接種率下降為病例數增加主因。該國去年報告逾2.1萬例。
bwqTFzmmAF2Om7WPLWdN_g.en: Tuberculosis in Mexico is rising. As of 23 March this year, 3,422 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 32 states, mainly in Baja California in the northwest, Veracruz in the east, Chiapas in the south, Nuevo León in the northeast and Tamaulipas. Experts say that cross-border population movement and declining vaccination coverage after the COVID-19 pandemic are the main reasons for the rise in cases. The country reported more than 21,000 cases last year.

VkV-BraII9UK1d48LmYMGw.zh: 美國疫情持續,今年截至3/20共32州累計報告1,478例確定病例,其中74例住院,病患以5-19歲年齡層族群(781例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(668例),其次為猶他州(275例)及德州(147例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他/德州,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至3/20累計報告7,584例確定病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以西部哈利斯科州(4,439例)、南部恰帕斯州(650例)、中部墨西哥城(563例)為多。全國各州自去年迄今皆有報告病例,並以1-4歲兒童病例為多。 葉門疫情嚴峻,政府控制區於今年1月報告逾1,200例確定及8例死亡病例,另哈德拉毛沿海地區病例數急遽上升,該區疫苗接種率僅為7%,當局表示非政府控制區的疫情可能更加嚴重。估計該國去(2025)年累計逾2.3萬確定病例。
VkV-BraII9UK1d48LmYMGw.en: The United States outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 1,478 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 32 states, of which 74 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (781 cases), and cases are concentrated in South Carolina (668 cases), followed by Utah (275 cases) and Texas (147 cases). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah and Texas, and 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 20 March this year, 7,584 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 8 deaths. Cases are concentrated in western Jalisco State (4,439 cases), southern Chiapas State (650 cases) and Mexico City in the central region (563 cases). All states have reported cases since last year, mainly among children aged 1–4 years. Yemen's outbreak is severe: in government-controlled areas, more than 1,200 confirmed cases and 8 deaths were reported in January this year, and cases have risen sharply in the coastal area of Hadramawt, where vaccination coverage is only 7%. Authorities say the outbreak in areas not controlled by the government may be even more severe. The country is estimated to have reported more than 23,000 confirmed cases cumulatively last year.

Oebqut419QAZTYQzvzFFDQ.zh: WHO PAHO於3/2宣布,將於今年11月就美國及墨西哥之「麻疹消除狀態」進行審查,兩國之疫情狀況如下:WHO PAHO  美國今年截至3/5共31州累計報告1,277例確定病例,其中62例住院,23%為5歲以下兒童,77%為19歲以下族群,93%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告662例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(184例),近期疫情集中於德克薩斯/猶他/科羅拉多/北達科他州。 墨西哥疫情持續,今年截至3/6累計報告6,104例確定病例,其中7例死亡,病例數以中西部哈利斯科州(3,604例)、南部恰帕斯州(540例)、中部墨西哥城(424例)為多。
Oebqut419QAZTYQzvzFFDQ.en: WHO/PAHO announced on 2 March that the measles elimination status of the United States and Mexico will be reviewed in November this year. The current situation in the two countries is as follows. United States: as of 5 March this year, 1,277 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 31 states, of which 62 were hospitalized. Of the cases, 23% were children under 5 years and 77% were under 19 years; 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 662 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (184 cases); recent outbreaks have been concentrated in Texas, Utah, Colorado and North Dakota. Mexico: the outbreak continues, with 6,104 confirmed cases reported cumulatively as of 6 March this year, including 7 deaths. Cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (3,604 cases), southern Chiapas (540 cases) and central Mexico City (424 cases).

rYCJnMBVInLfXoX2bT_puQ.en: Kazakhstan's outbreak is rising. As of 20 February this year, 3,343 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 84.2% were children under 14 years and 77.6% were unvaccinated children, distributed across nine regions including Astana and Almaty. Authorities have issued prevention orders, including expanding immunization campaigns, temporarily banning unvaccinated children from entering schools and kindergartens, and requiring health workers to be vaccinated. The United States outbreak continues: as of 19 February this year, 982 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 states, of which 38 were hospitalized; 94% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 632 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (117 cases) and Florida (64 cases). Florida's patients are mainly linked to Ave Maria University in Collier County, which has strengthened outbreak prevention and control measures. Mexico's outbreak continues: as of 23 February this year, 4,497 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 5 deaths; cases are concentrated in west-central Jalisco (2,662 cases) and southern Chiapas (393 cases). The outbreak in Mexico began in early last year; 6,444 confirmed cases, including 27 deaths, were reported in 2025, mainly among infants aged 1–4 years (1,548 cases). In north London, an outbreak has occurred: England has reported 96 confirmed cases so far this year, mainly in London and the West Midlands, mostly among children under 10 years. Twenty per cent of infected children are being treated in hospital, and all hospitalized children were not fully vaccinated. Authorities have set up temporary vaccination sites to encourage catch-up vaccination.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

Da4qKSHaTffD4r2TnYWB7Q.en: Central America and Mexico have experienced outbreaks since 2023. As of 3 February this year, more than 1,240 human cases and more than 150,000 animal cases have been reported. On 20 January, the US CDC issued a health advisory on New World screwworm (NWS), noting that Tamaulipas State in Mexico, which borders Texas, reported 8 animal cases. As of 21 January, no human or animal infections related to this outbreak had been found within the United States. Given the possibility of spread, the advisory provides guidance for clinicians, health departments, laboratories, veterinarians and the public.

XhZTg38YPsy9sM7HgTr6zw.en: Measles continues in Mexico. As of 23 January this year, 987 confirmed cases had been reported, indicating that current control measures are insufficient. Cases are concentrated in Jalisco state in the central-west (521 cases) and Chiapas state in the south (200 cases). On 23 January, Mexico also reported its first death of the year, in a case residing in Michoacán state in the central-west. Mexico reported two imported cases last February, after which an outbreak developed. As of 23 January, 32 states had reported 7,417 confirmed cases since then, mainly among children aged 1–4, and 26 of these cases have died. Authorities continue large-scale vaccination.

eu7ww-ye481FvTwsUHqNsQ.en: Measles continues in Mexico: in weeks 1–2 of 2026, 506 new confirmed cases were reported, more than half from Jalisco state in the central-west. Last year, the country reported 6,427 confirmed cases across 31 states, including 24 deaths; cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (70%). The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) plans an online meeting with the United States and Mexico on 13 April to review their measles elimination status. Kazakhstan has reported 370 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 16 January this year, of which 298 were children under 14, and 85% of infected children were unvaccinated. Cases are concentrated in Zhambyl region in the southeast (191 cases). The country reported 4,240 cases last year, and estimates indicate 24,000–28,000 cases in 2024. Authorities say vaccination coverage among target-age children is low and refusals have increased, which has sustained the outbreak. The United States has reported 171 confirmed cases this year across 9 states, 2 of them hospitalised. Most cases are in South Carolina (145 confirmed). The state has identified 409 contacts and plans monitoring until 9 February. 95% of patients in the country were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. US vaccination rates have continued to lag in recent years, and recent activity is concentrated in South Carolina and Utah.

gkVoXu3rj-Td9juqMIet-A.en: Tokyo Metropolis reported one confirmed case: a man in his 30s who drives buses between Tokyo's Haneda airport and other airports, with no history of overseas travel. The patient developed fever, conjunctival injection and rash on 23 December. That afternoon he visited a hardware store in Toyosu, Tokyo, and on 24 December he worked on buses departing from Haneda and Narita airports. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and contact identification, and urge people with the same activity history not to use public transport. Anyone who develops fever, rash, cough, runny nose or conjunctival injection should seek medical care promptly. Tokyo has reported 33 confirmed cases so far this year, 63% of them locally acquired. Mexico's situation is rising. As of 26 December this year, 26 states had reported 6,050 confirmed cases, including 24 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (4,481), Jalisco state in the central-west (516) and Guerrero state in the southwest (237); deaths were most numerous in Chihuahua (21). The outbreak has rebounded since November, with more than 100 confirmed cases in the past four weeks. The main age group is children aged 0–4 (1,559 cases), followed by those aged 25–29 (690) and 5–9 (655). Over 90% were unvaccinated.

2jMIZZlhkH5IBj46T-E71w.en: The Philippines reported 4,843 confirmed cases in 2025 as of 6 December, compared with 3,748 in the same period of 2024. 73% were unvaccinated. Cases were most numerous in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) with 1,027, the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in the south with 768, and the Calabarzon region in the north with 505. Authorities have announced that an intensified vaccination programme will start next year (2026) (Philippine News Agency, 20 December). Mexico's situation is rising. This year as of 19 December, 5,860 confirmed cases had been reported, including 24 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (4,473), Jalisco state in the central-west (462) and Guerrero state in the southwest (227). The main age group is children aged 0–4, and over 90% were unvaccinated (RECORD, 21 December).

MRdvNbYbj1VBqukXOkxF5Q.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週墨西哥新增1例H5N2流感人類感染病例;美國新增1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例。  禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共25國於2025/11/20-28期間新增654起H5N1 疫情,德國179起、法國140起、英國110起、荷蘭50起、比利時36起、義大利35起、加拿大19起、美國17起、捷克/芬蘭各9起、奧地利/西班牙各8起、波蘭7起、拉脫維亞6起、丹麥/瑞典各4 起、斯洛伐克/斯洛維亞/瑞士/葡萄牙各2起、保加利亞/匈牙利/南韓/愛爾蘭/立陶宛各1起。 挪威2025/11/24新增1起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計18州報告1,082 (1)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第46週計383個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(紐澤西州)共1個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  墨西哥新增1例H5N2流感人類感染病例,病患為墨西哥城23歲女性,近期無旅遊史,9/14開始出現咳嗽、發燒、吞嚥疼痛、胸痛及咳血等症狀,30日經實驗室檢測為H5型,近期經PAHO實驗室確診為H5N2,病患接受奧司他韋(oseltamivir)治療並於10/11出院,當局表示居住環境有鳥類及家禽,且經檢測出H5型;本案為該國及全球第2例H5N2病例,首例為2024年墨西哥州之死亡病例。另該國今年4月曾通報1例H5N1死亡病例,PAHO表示H5 型禽流感散發病例多與直接接觸受感染動物或受污染環境有關,迄無人傳人情形,建議持續加強動物及人類之跨部門監測。 美國佛蒙特州新增1例H1N2v流感人類感染病例,為年齡18歲個案,於第40週(9/28-10/4)發病,經住院後已康復,迄未確認是否曾接觸豬或其他動物,目前尚無人傳人跡象,亦未具人際間傳播能力;當局表示該案為該國今年第2例H1N2v病例,另自2019年迄今累計報告18例H1N2v病例。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感2例,H5N1流感30例 (2003年迄今累計992*例),H5N2流感1例 (迄今累計2例),H5N5流感1例 (迄今累計1例),H9N2流感32例(迄今累計162例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計67國家/地區通報4,857起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
MRdvNbYbj1VBqukXOkxF5Q.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: this week Mexico reported one new human H5N2 influenza infection, and the United States reported one new human H1N2v influenza infection. Animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 25 countries reported a total of 654 new H5N1 outbreaks between 20 and 28 November 2025: Germany 179, France 140, United Kingdom 110, Netherlands 50, Belgium 36, Italy 35, Canada 19, United States 17, Czechia and Finland 9 each, Austria and Spain 8 each, Poland 7, Latvia 6, Denmark and Sweden 4 each, Slovakia, Slovenia, Switzerland and Portugal 2 each, and Bulgaria, Hungary, South Korea, Ireland and Lithuania 1 each. Norway reported one new H5 (N untyped) outbreak on 24 November 2025. US dairy cattle infections: Cumulatively since March last year, 1,082 (1) outbreaks have been reported in cattle herds across 18 states, mainly concentrated recently in Idaho. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 46, 383 sampling sites provided test reports, and one state (New Jersey) had one sampling site detect H5-positive results. Other updates: Mexico reported one new human H5N2 infection, in a 23-year-old woman in Mexico City with no recent travel history. She developed cough, fever, sore throat, chest pain and coughing up blood from 14 September; on the 30th, laboratory testing identified H5 type, and PAHO later confirmed H5N2. She was treated with oseltamivir and discharged on 11 October. Authorities said her residence had birds and poultry, and H5 was detected. This is the second H5N2 human case in the country and globally; the first was a fatal case in Mexico State in 2024. The country also reported one fatal H5N1 case in April this year. PAHO said sporadic human H5 avian influenza cases are mostly associated with direct contact with infected animals or contaminated environments, with no human-to-human transmission to date, and recommended continued cross-sectoral surveillance of animals and humans. The US state of Vermont reported one new human H1N2v infection in an 18-year-old case who fell ill in week 40 (28 September–4 October). The patient was hospitalized and has recovered. It has not been confirmed whether the patient had contact with pigs or other animals; there are no signs of human-to-human transmission, and the virus does not have sustained human-to-human transmission capacity. Authorities said this is the country's second H1N2v case this year, and 18 H1N2v cases have been reported cumulatively since 2019. Annual summary: Human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza; 30 H5N1 influenza (992* cumulative since 2003); 1 H5N2 influenza (2 cumulative); 1 H5N5 influenza (1 cumulative); 32 H9N2 influenza (162 cumulative); 2 H10N3 influenza (6 cumulative). Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 67 countries and areas have reported 4,857 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH conducted a risk assessment of H5 viruses on 28 July. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the virus is widespread in wild and domestic animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. The risk to the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments, depending mainly on the mode and duration of contact, protection, and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoiding drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response measures.

Qxh_68bpFe4hJlM9i-QKCg.en: Bangladesh update: In the past day, 912 new cases and 3 deaths were reported. Year to date, 80,634 cases and 318 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the most cases, 18,765, in Barisal division in the south. Since July, more than 10,000 cases have been reported each month. Mexico: The outbreak is rising. In the past week, 992 new cases were reported. As of 27 October this year, 14,652 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, most in Veracruz state in the east (2,257 cases). The main serotype detected is DENV-3. United States: Miami-Dade County in Florida reported three new local cases in the past week. The state has reported 56 cases cumulatively this year, mainly in Broward, Hillsborough, Miami-Dade and Pasco counties, and the main serotype detected is DENV-3.

ISI_BpsGJJyoQpojVMzPSA.zh: 墨西哥多個州於10月初爆發群聚疫情,疫情多發生於日托中心、幼兒園及小學等,病患以5歲以下族群為主,病毒型別為A16及A6型等;當局宣布停課及全面清消。
ISI_BpsGJJyoQpojVMzPSA.en: Several Mexican states had cluster outbreaks in early October, mainly at day-care centres, kindergartens and primary schools. Patients are mainly under 5 years old, and the virus types include A16 and A6, among others. Authorities have announced class suspensions and comprehensive disinfection.

n0vK1PMSz5qQ025k0OG-RA.zh: 墨西哥截至10/13報告逾1.1萬例疑病例,其中4,915例確診及23例死亡,病例遍及全國22州,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州4,386例為多,該國疫苗覆蓋率為87%,仍低於95%目標,由於兒童疫苗接種率低、農村及周邊地區健康差距大,與此次疫情上升相關。 以色列新增1例死亡病例,該名幼童未接種疫苗,今年迄今累計7例,所有病例均未滿2歲半,目前仍有19例住院,其中4例仍在ICU治療中。
n0vK1PMSz5qQ025k0OG-RA.en: Mexico: As of 13 October, more than 11,000 suspected cases had been reported, including 4,915 confirmed cases and 23 deaths. Cases have been reported in 22 states across the country, most in north-western Chihuahua state (4,386 cases). Mexico's vaccination coverage is 87%, still below the 95% target. Low childhood vaccination rates and large health disparities between rural and surrounding areas are associated with the rise in this outbreak. Israel: One new death was reported, in an unvaccinated young child. So far this year, the cumulative total is seven cases, all of them children under two and a half years old. Currently 19 patients are hospitalized, four of whom remain in intensive care.

ZprFmFN5WwQ2DWvcID00nA.zh: 英國英蘭地區今年累計報告742例,該地區病例數自4月開始上升,疫情影響倫敦及西北部地區,惟於7月中旬趨緩,超過70%病例為10歲以下兒童,並報告1例兒童死亡案例。該地區去(2024)年報告2,911例,為2012年以來新高。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至9/3共42州報告1,431例,並報告35起疫情 ,其中178例住院及3例死亡,3月為疫情高峰,目前已趨緩;加拿大截至8/30共10省報告4,849例,其中1例死亡,該國此次疫情流行基因型為D8型;墨西哥截至9/9報告9,439例,其中4,482例確診及19例死亡,該國各州皆有報告病例,病例數以契瓦瓦州報告逾4,100例為多。
ZprFmFN5WwQ2DWvcID00nA.en: In England, 742 cases have been reported this year. Case numbers in the region began rising in April, affecting London and the north-west, but slowed in mid-July. More than 70% of cases are children under 10 years old, and one child death has been reported. The region reported 2,911 cases last year (2024), the highest since 2012. North America outbreak update: in the United States, as of 3 September this year, 42 states had reported 1,431 cases and 35 outbreaks, of which 178 were hospitalized and 3 died; March was the peak, and the outbreak has now slowed. In Canada, as of 30 August, 10 provinces had reported 4,849 cases, including one death; the genotype circulating in this outbreak is D8. In Mexico, as of 9 September, 9,439 cases had been reported, of which 4,482 were confirmed and 19 died; cases have been reported in all states, most of them in Chihuahua State, which reported more than 4,100 cases.

Zj5FYjpX9USBGC9yaNv2JQ.zh: 墨西哥中部哈利斯科州報告1例死亡病例,為68歲男性個案,病患於今(2025)年5月中旬曾被受感染牛隻咬傷,數日後曾出現疲勞及咬傷部位麻痺等症狀就醫,於8/7出現嚴重神經系統症狀至私人醫院,診斷疑狂犬病後,於17日轉院,27日死亡,28日經實驗室確診,當局已啟動接觸者監測並呼籲民眾及時為犬/貓/其他高風險動物接種狂犬病疫苗。該國於2024年報告至少2例病例,分別由貓及野生哺乳動物傳播;另今年報告1例被臭鼬咬傷之死亡病例。
Zj5FYjpX9USBGC9yaNv2JQ.en: In Jalisco State, central Mexico, one death was reported in a 68-year-old man. The patient had been bitten by an infected cow in mid-May this year. A few days later he developed fatigue and numbness at the bite site and sought medical care. On 7 August he developed severe neurological symptoms and went to a private hospital. After rabies was suspected, he was transferred on 17 August and died on 27 August; laboratory confirmation was made on 28 August. Authorities have activated contact monitoring and urge the public to vaccinate dogs, cats and other high-risk animals against rabies in a timely manner. Mexico reported at least two cases in 2024, transmitted by cats and wild mammals respectively. One death from a skunk bite was reported this year.

guidLIQv4jo8SDml9afZwA.zh: 墨西哥截至8/21已報告40例人類病例及1例死亡,病例主要分布於恰帕斯(36例)及坎佩切州(3例),且已蔓延至塔巴斯科州(1例),疫情係由家畜/禽感染及跨國動物遷移引起,顯示該國南部具有公共衛生及農業風險,並有往北擴散風險;貝里斯於近期亦報告首例人類感染病例。
guidLIQv4jo8SDml9afZwA.en: As of 21 August, Mexico had reported 40 human cases and one death. Cases are mainly in Chiapas State (36) and Campeche State (3), and have spread to Tabasco State (1). The outbreak is caused by infection of livestock and poultry and by cross-border animal movement, indicating public health and agricultural risks in southern Mexico, with a risk of spread northward. Belize also recently reported its first human case.

79EBam7aLp2bXIRRyvFC-Q.zh: 墨西哥今年截至8/22累計報告4,200餘例,其中契瓦瓦州逾3,900例為多,死亡數累計15例,病例集中於0-4歲嬰幼兒族群。 印東爪哇省今年迄今報告逾2,000例,其中17例死亡,病例多集中於漯水縣(Sumenep),病患多未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,當局已宣布進入公共衛生緊急狀態,該國東部巴布亞省於2018年爆發大規模疫情,造成數十例死亡。因該國疫苗接種率僅72%,部分省分低於50%,疫苗覆蓋率不佳,疫情與接種覆蓋率之波動有關,當局呼籲民眾儘速接種疫苗。
79EBam7aLp2bXIRRyvFC-Q.en: Mexico has reported more than 4,200 cases this year as of 22 August, of which more than 3,900 are in Chihuahua State, and 15 deaths cumulatively; cases are concentrated among infants and young children aged 0–4. East Java Province, Indonesia, has reported more than 2,000 cases this year, including 17 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Sumenep Regency, and most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Authorities have declared a public health emergency. Papua Province in eastern Indonesia had a large-scale outbreak in 2018 that caused dozens of deaths. With national vaccination coverage at only 72%, and below 50% in some provinces, poor vaccination coverage is linked to fluctuations in the outbreak; authorities urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.zh: 日本今年截至7/27累計報告4例,分別為千葉縣3例及東京都1例,該病原體不存在於該國自然環境,主要發生於前往流行區之旅客,該國2012-23共計報告34例病例,其中33例為境外感染,分別自美國31例(亞利桑那州19例/加州8例)、墨西哥1例、加拉瓜1例,1例為本土病例,其曾接觸過球孢子菌樣本。病例主要以20多歲為主,並以男性為多(男性22例/女性12例);球黴菌症屬該國第四類感染症,病例必須在診斷後立即通報。 美洲之美國西南部、墨西哥北部、中美洲和南美洲部分地區為地方性流行區,除美國外,其他國家未列入正式全國監測或法定通報疾病。墨西哥感染盛行率與美國西南部相近,於2000-19年報告766例,北部乾旱州份(如索諾拉、下加州)為主要流行區;巴西與阿根廷病例逐年增加,甚至擴展至過去之非流行區,巴西於1978-2021年共計報告292例,主要來自東北部巴西皮奧伊州(Piauí )和馬拉昂州(Maranhão)。
jR9Nhls1xwIljgdxjXb6cA.en: Japan has cumulatively reported four cases this year as of 27 July: three in Chiba Prefecture and one in Tokyo Metropolis. The pathogen does not exist in Japan's natural environment, and cases occur mainly in travellers who visit endemic areas. From 2012 to 2023, Japan reported 34 cases in total, 33 of them acquired abroad: 31 from the United States (19 in Arizona and 8 in California), one from Mexico and one from Nicaragua. One case was locally acquired, in a person who had been exposed to Coccidioides specimens. Most cases are in patients in their 20s and are predominantly male (22 men and 12 women). Coccidioidomycosis is a Category IV notifiable infectious disease in Japan, and cases must be reported immediately upon diagnosis. In the Americas, the south-western United States, northern Mexico, Central America and parts of South America are endemic areas. Apart from the United States, other countries do not include the disease in formal national surveillance or statutory notification. Mexico's infection prevalence is similar to that of the south-western United States; Mexico reported 766 cases in 2000–2019, mainly in arid northern states such as Sonora and Baja California. Cases in Brazil and Argentina are increasing year by year and have even spread into previously non-endemic areas. Brazil reported 292 cases in 1978–2021, mainly from the north-eastern Brazilian states of Piauí and Maranhão.

Rpe1NJIoEURs6Faas86_ng.zh: 墨西哥中部薩卡特卡斯州報告1例病例,為17歲女性個案,病患於6月下旬睡覺時被臭鼬咬傷,僅進行傷口消毒,未進行狂犬病治療,於出現相關症狀後就醫,目前病況危急且收治於加護病房,病患為該州自1987年以來首例人類病例,當局已於該州南部設立警戒線,以進行野生動物檢測,另對居民發布疫情警報。
Rpe1NJIoEURs6Faas86_ng.en: In Zacatecas State, central Mexico, one case was reported: a 17-year-old woman who was bitten by a skunk while sleeping in late June. She only had the wound disinfected and did not receive rabies treatment. She sought medical care after symptoms appeared; her condition is critical and she is in intensive care. She is the first human case in the state since 1987. Authorities have set up an alert zone in the south of the state for wildlife testing and have issued a warning to residents.

7SH3zz-BkfFeKNDMsecHrA.zh: 墨西哥今年迄今報告逾7,000例疑病例,其中超過3,900例確診及14例死亡,病例數以北部契瓦瓦州逾3,600例為多,且以0-4歲嬰幼兒為主,惟實際病例數可能更高,該國目前疫苗覆蓋率僅76%,當局已啟動監測及接種疫苗計畫。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年迄今報告4,057例,其中122例死亡(CFR:3%),由於當地交通不便及局勢不穩定,死亡率偏高,當局已規劃疫苗接種計畫。 葉門今年截至7/14累計報告2萬餘例疑病例及178例死亡(CFR: 0.85%),病例集中於西部荷台達省及札馬爾省。
7SH3zz-BkfFeKNDMsecHrA.en: Mexico has reported more than 7,000 suspected cases this year, of which more than 3,900 are confirmed, and 14 deaths. Cases are highest in northern Chihuahua State, with more than 3,600, and are mainly among infants and young children aged 0–4. Actual case numbers may be higher. Mexico's vaccination coverage is only 76%, and authorities have launched a surveillance and vaccination programme. In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Kivu Province has reported 4,057 cases this year, of which 122 died (CFR: 3%). The high mortality is attributed to poor transport and instability in the area, and authorities have planned a vaccination programme. Yemen has reported more than 20,000 suspected cases and 178 deaths cumulatively as of 14 July this year (CFR: 0.85%). Cases are concentrated in Hudaydah and Dhamar governorates in the west.

iDm0jHC-G2fsTQAaC0zT2Q.zh: 美洲地區疫情持續,截至今年6月中旬報告逾7,100例及13例死亡,與去(2024)年同期244例,上升29倍,其中以加拿大(3,170例,1例死亡)為多,其次為墨西哥(2,597例,9例死亡)及美國(1,227例,3例死亡),餘有6國病例數介於1-60例間,多數病例為境外移入,受影響族群以5歲以下兒童及10-19歲青少年最為嚴重。病例數增加顯示免疫接種缺口,PAHO呼籲各國維持95%兩劑疫苗覆蓋率。WHO表示今年截至6/6,全球報告逾18萬例疑病例及8.8萬例確診。 吉爾吉斯今年截至6/17累計報告超過8,200例,其中9例死亡,病例數以首都比什凱克、南部奧什州及北部楚伊州為多,近期西部賈拉拉巴德州病例數亦持續增加,惟該國尚未宣布爆發疫情,疫情主因與大量兒童未接種疫苗有關。 日本神奈川縣報告1例10多歲青少年,該病患曾於6/21參訪大阪萬國博覽會,於會場停留約6小時,並於當日出現症狀,7/3確診,患者近期無海外旅遊史,接觸史不明。當局及主辦單位呼籲當日前往參觀人員留意自身健康情形。
iDm0jHC-G2fsTQAaC0zT2Q.en: Measles activity in the Americas continues. As of mid-June this year, more than 7,100 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, 29 times the 244 cases reported in the same period of 2024. Canada reports the most (3,170 cases, 1 death), followed by Mexico (2,597 cases, 9 deaths) and the United States (1,227 cases, 3 deaths). Six other countries have between 1 and 60 cases each. Most cases are imported. The most affected groups are children under 5 and adolescents aged 10–19. The rise in cases indicates gaps in immunization, and PAHO calls on countries to maintain 95% coverage with two doses of vaccine. WHO reports that as of 6 June this year, more than 180,000 suspected and 88,000 confirmed cases have been reported globally. Kyrgyzstan has reported more than 8,200 cumulative cases so far this year as of 17 June, including 9 deaths. Cases are mainly in the capital, Bishkek, Osh Region in the south and Chui Region in the north, and recently cases have also continued to rise in Jalal-Abad Region in the west. The country has not declared an outbreak; the main cause is that many children are unvaccinated. In Japan, Kanagawa Prefecture reported one teenager, who visited Expo 2025 Osaka on 21 June and stayed at the venue for about 6 hours, developed symptoms that day, and was confirmed on 3 July. The patient had no recent overseas travel, and the contact history is unknown. Authorities and the organizers urge those who visited on that day to monitor their health.

dGiTC-Xc334Dmthz0Ichew.zh: 北美疫情更新,美國截至6/19共36州報告1,214例及3例死亡,並報告23起疫情;加拿大截至6/23共9省3,381例,其中1例死亡,病例數以安大略省逾2,100例為多,其次為亞伯達省960餘例,該國近期呈下降趨勢,今年病例數為1998年以來最高;墨西哥今年截至6/7累計報告5,584例,其中2,153例確診及4例死亡,病例數以赤瓦瓦州逾2,000例為多。
dGiTC-Xc334Dmthz0Ichew.en: North American measles update: As of 19 June, the United States has reported 1,214 cases in 36 states, including 3 deaths, and 23 outbreaks. As of 23 June, Canada has reported 3,381 cases in 9 provinces, including 1 death. Ontario has the most, with more than 2,100 cases, followed by Alberta with more than 960. Cases in Canada have recently trended downward, but this year's case count is the highest since 1998. As of 7 June this year, Mexico has cumulatively reported 5,584 cases, of which 2,153 were confirmed and 4 died. Chihuahua State has the most, with more than 2,000 cases.

deAVYNuIKM9iAQcjLzegUg.zh: 墨西哥哈利斯科州疫情上升,自今年截至6月中旬已累計130例疑及20例確診病例,當局已發布警示並啟動相關監測措施。該州去年報告310例疑及68例確診病例。 歐洲蒙特內哥羅5/11報告該國首例,截至6/10累計2例病例,據調查感染源為農場羊隻,當局已撲殺並採取相關措施。
deAVYNuIKM9iAQcjLzegUg.en: Jalisco State in Mexico has seen rising cases. From the start of this year to mid-June, 130 suspected and 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities have issued a warning and launched related surveillance measures. The state reported 310 suspected and 68 confirmed cases last year. Montenegro in Europe reported its first case on 11 May, and as of 10 June, 2 cases had been reported cumulatively. The investigation found the source of infection was sheep on a farm, and authorities have culled the animals and taken related measures.

k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.zh: PAHO於5/31發布百日咳流病警報,美洲7國病例數呈上升趨勢,其中,以美國逾1萬例病例及5例死亡最為嚴峻,餘有巴西/墨西哥/厄瓜多/祕魯/哥倫比亞/巴拉圭,病例數在37-1,634例間。該地區於2012年病例數達高峰後,持續下降,惟於2023年開始上升,去年報告4.4萬例,病例數增加與新冠疫情期間疫苗覆蓋率下降相關,PAHO呼籲各國加強監測及加強疫苗接種等措施。 日本疫情持續,近1週(5/19-25)通報2,660例,較前1週2,299例增加360餘例,持續創2018年以來新高,新增病例數以新潟縣(148)為多,其次為兵庫縣(139)。今年迄今已累計逾2.2萬例,並有報告嬰兒重症及死亡案例,專家表示此次疫情嚴峻與易感性族群增加相關,由於疫情期間防護措施,導致對多種呼吸道傳染病免疫力下降,且抗藥性菌株於去年秋天以來持續傳播。今年報告2例未達接種月齡之新生兒死亡病例,且此次疫情集中於10多歲青少年族群,建議常與家中嬰幼兒接觸之家庭成員接種疫苗。
k422FmmOJ-Ac_bIIosZw6A.en: PAHO issued a pertussis epidemic alert on 31 May. Among seven countries in the Americas where case numbers are rising, the United States is the most severe, with more than 10,000 cases and 5 deaths. The others are Brazil, Mexico, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia and Paraguay, with case numbers ranging from 37 to 1,634. After peaking in 2012, case numbers in the region continued to decline, but they have risen since 2023, with 44,000 cases reported last year. The increase is associated with declining vaccination coverage during the COVID-19 pandemic. PAHO urges countries to strengthen surveillance and vaccination measures. Japan's outbreak continues: in the most recent week (19–25 May), 2,660 cases were reported, an increase of more than 360 from 2,299 the previous week, a continued high since 2018. Niigata Prefecture had the most new cases (148), followed by Hyogo Prefecture (139). So far this year, more than 22,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, and severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported. Experts say the severity of this outbreak is linked to an increase in susceptible populations: protective measures during the pandemic reduced immunity to several respiratory infectious diseases, and drug-resistant strains have continued to spread since last autumn. This year, two newborns too young to be vaccinated have died; the outbreak is concentrated among teenagers, and family members who often have contact with infants and young children at home are advised to get vaccinated.

eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.zh: 美洲:美國今年截至5/29報告14起疫情,累計33州1,088例,其中133例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾740例為多,近期德州地區疫情已趨緩,惟其他州仍持續報告零星病例,南達科他州報告今年首例;墨西哥今年截至5/12報告逾 4,200例,其中1,520例確診及4例死亡,以奇瓦瓦州(1,434)為多。 亞洲:吉爾吉斯今年截至5/27累計報告逾7,300例,主要分布於首都比斯凱克,另北部楚河州及南部奧什州病例數亦較高,疫情分布廣泛,遍及都會及農村地區,94%病例未接種疫苗;蒙古今年迄今報告3,100餘例,病例主要集中於校園,當局呼籲學生、教職員及與學齡族群密切接觸人員接種疫苗。 非洲:摩洛哥今年累計報告超過40,000例,其中79例死亡(CFR:0.2%),目前當局持續進行全國性疫苗接種。
eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.en: Americas: as of 29 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,088 cases cumulatively across 33 states, including 133 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 740 cases. The Texas outbreak has recently slowed, but other states continue to report sporadic cases, and South Dakota reported its first case this year. As of 12 May, Mexico had reported over 4,200 cases this year, including 1,520 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, mainly in Chihuahua State (1,434). Asia: as of 27 May this year, Kyrgyzstan has reported over 7,300 cases cumulatively, mainly in the capital Bishkek, with high numbers also in the northern Chui Region and the southern Osh Region. The outbreak is widespread across urban and rural areas, and 94% of cases were unvaccinated. Mongolia has reported over 3,100 cases so far this year, concentrated in schools, and authorities urge students, school staff and people in close contact with school-age children to be vaccinated. Africa: Morocco has reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively this year, including 79 deaths (CFR 0.2%), and nationwide vaccination is ongoing.

Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/15報告14起疫情,累計31州1,024例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多;加拿大今年截至5/3共7省1,846例,以安大略省(1,460)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告1,300餘例。 烏克蘭疫情上升,今年至3月報告472例,較去(2024)年增加20.5倍,並報告2例兒童死亡,病例集中於西部地區之外喀爾巴阡/車夫契/敖得薩州,由於當地戰事持續使公共衛生服務受到干擾,降低疫苗接種率,且人口流動加劇疾病傳播風險。
Mw_nMxlTzJ2K1ZVC0TfFyQ.en: North America update: as of 15 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,024 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. As of 3 May, Canada had 1,846 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,460), and case numbers in Alberta have also risen rapidly. In northern Mexico, the outbreak in Chihuahua State is severe, with more than 1,300 cases reported so far this year. Ukraine's outbreak is rising: 472 cases were reported through March this year, a 20.5-fold increase compared with last year, and 2 child deaths have been reported. Cases are concentrated in the western oblasts of Zakarpattia, Chernivtsi and Odesa. Ongoing conflict in the area is disrupting public health services and lowering vaccination rates, and population movement is increasing the risk of spread.

MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.zh: 中南美洲近年病例數上升,巴拿馬/哥斯大黎加/加拉瓜/宏都拉斯/瓜地馬拉/薩爾瓦多/墨西哥等國均有人類感染病例。另加拿大於今年3月報告1例80歲男性病例,具哥斯大黎加旅遊史,顯示其可能透過國際旅遊傳播,增加國際傳播風險。螺旋蠅為寄生性蠅類,其幼蟲可寄生於人類及動物之傷口或天然腔道,造成「蠅蛆症」,目前無疫苗或特效藥物。
MtnoDj3DtXCdMWVpRQnxxA.en: Human infections have increased in Central and South America in recent years, with human cases reported in Panama, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Mexico and other countries. In addition, Canada reported a case in an 80-year-old man in March this year who had a travel history to Costa Rica, indicating that the disease may spread through international travel and increase the risk of international transmission. The screwworm fly is a parasitic fly whose larvae can parasitize wounds or natural body cavities of humans and animals, causing myiasis. There is currently no vaccine or specific drug.

JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.zh: 摩洛哥自2023年10月爆發疫情以來,截至今年4/13全國共12個地區報告2.5萬餘例疑病例,其中1.3萬餘例確診及184例死亡,該國於今年1月下旬達高峰後,已連續10週呈下降趨勢,經基因定序顯示多為B3基因型,該基因型於非洲地區流行,亦與全球疫情相關。目前疫情已受控制,惟部分地區仍持續傳播,惟該國麻疹-德國麻疹(MR)疫苗接種率僅73.6%,WHO評估該國未接種疫苗/未完全接種疫苗者與免疫功能低下者風險為「中」,由於處非/歐洲交接處,人員流動頻繁,評估區域及全球風險為「中」。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/8報告14起疫情,累計31州1,001例,其中126例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,今年僅4個多月,病例數已接近2019年全年病例數(1,274),其為1992年以來病例數最高峰;加拿大今年截至4/26共7省1,506例,以安大略省(1,249)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/12累計報告362例;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告954例,其中1例死亡,該國今年迄今累計1,003例。 澳大利亞爆發近6年來最嚴重疫情,今年迄今累計報告72例,超過去(2024)年全年病例數(57例),分布以維多利亞州27例為多,其次為新南威爾斯州(21)及西澳大利亞州(18),超過6成病例為29歲以下族群。
JID15r3l9zYEN3QeVd_R_w.en: Morocco: since its outbreak began in October 2023, as of 13 April this year, 12 regions nationwide have reported more than 25,000 suspected cases, of which more than 13,000 were confirmed and 184 died. The country peaked in late January this year and has since declined for 10 consecutive weeks. Genetic sequencing shows that most cases are genotype B3, which circulates in Africa and is also linked to the global outbreak. The outbreak is now under control, but transmission continues in some areas. Morocco's measles-rubella (MR) vaccination coverage is only 73.6%. WHO assesses the risk for unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated people and immunocompromised people in the country as moderate. Because the country sits at the junction of Africa and Europe with frequent population movement, the regional and global risk is also assessed as moderate. North America update: as of 8 May, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,001 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 126 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. In just over four months this year, case numbers are close to the 2019 full-year total (1,274), the highest since 1992. As of 26 April, Canada had 1,506 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,249); Alberta's case numbers have risen rapidly, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 12 May. The outbreak in Chihuahua State in northern Mexico is severe, with 954 cases reported this year so far, including 1 death; the country has reported 1,003 cases so far this year. Australia is experiencing its most severe outbreak in nearly six years, with 72 cases reported so far this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (57 cases). Victoria had the most (27 cases), followed by New South Wales (21) and Western Australia (18). More than 60% of cases were aged 29 years or younger.

dNS1TfLxgqA9ygusWOjFjQ.zh: 日本疫情更新,近1週(4/21-27)通報2,176例,高於前1週1,884例,已連續5週達2018年以來單週最高紀錄,新增病例數以東京都/福岡縣(142)、新潟縣(132)及兵庫縣(110)為多。今年迄今已累計近1.2萬例,為去年全年病例數2倍以上,並發生嬰兒重症及死亡案例,且各地均有抗藥性菌株感染案例。小兒科學會呼籲家長應讓出生2個月以上嬰幼兒儘速接種常規疫苗。 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至5/2共31州報告835例,其中49例死亡,病例/死亡數皆高於去年全年總數(463/32),該國於疫情前之2016-19年間,每年報告約900例確診。 美國今年截至4/26累計報告逾9,000例,為去年同期之2倍,以西岸地區為多,華盛頓州報告逾1,000例,另俄勒岡(663)及加州(590)病例數亦高,該國近期疫情上升原因可能為接種率下降影響。
dNS1TfLxgqA9ygusWOjFjQ.en: Japan update: in the most recent week (21–27 April), 2,176 cases were reported, up from 1,884 the previous week, marking five consecutive weeks at the highest weekly level since 2018. The largest numbers of new cases were in Tokyo Metropolis / Fukuoka Prefecture (142), Niigata Prefecture (132) and Hyogo Prefecture (110). So far this year, nearly 12,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, more than double the full-year total for last year. Severe cases and deaths among infants have been reported, and drug-resistant strain infections have been reported in all regions. The Japanese Society of Pediatrics urges parents to have infants aged 2 months and older vaccinated with routine vaccines as soon as possible. Mexico's outbreak is rising: as of 2 May this year, 835 cases had been reported across 31 states, 49 of them fatal, exceeding last year's full-year totals (463 cases and 32 deaths). In 2016–19, before the outbreak, about 900 confirmed cases were reported each year. The United States reported more than 9,000 cases cumulatively as of 26 April this year, twice the same period last year, mainly on the West Coast. Washington State reported more than 1,000 cases, and Oregon (663) and California (590) also had high numbers. The recent rise may be linked to declining vaccination coverage.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.zh: WHO於4/28公布美洲今年截至4/18疫情概況,共6國報告超過2,300例,其中3例死亡,較去(2024)年同期上升11倍,以加拿大報告1,069例為多,其次為美國(800例,2例死亡)、墨西哥(421例,1例死亡),阿根廷/巴西/貝里斯報告2-21例間。因境外病例持續輸入導致疫情爆發,傳播鏈延長,影響範圍擴大,且美洲區疫苗覆蓋率不佳,僅約30%國家第一劑MMR疫苗覆蓋率超過95%目標,另新冠疫情、疫苗猶豫及醫療保健資源限制,致疫苗覆蓋率偏低,易感人群數上升。WHO評估該地區風險為高。其他區署疫情持續,且因資源限制、及公衛系統薄弱等因素,評估全球風險為中。
J3iNpOwwErfMBULdhmEehQ.en: WHO published on 28 April an overview of the Americas as of 18 April this year: 6 countries reported more than 2,300 cases, including 3 deaths, 11 times the figure for the same period last year. Canada reported the most, with 1,069 cases, followed by the United States (800 cases, 2 deaths) and Mexico (421 cases, 1 death); Argentina, Brazil and Belize reported between 2 and 21 cases each. Continuing imported cases have led to outbreaks, lengthening transmission chains and expanding the affected area. Vaccination coverage in the Americas is poor: only about 30% of countries have first-dose MMR coverage above the 95% target. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy and limited healthcare resources have lowered vaccination coverage and increased the number of susceptible people. WHO assesses the risk in the region as high. Outbreaks in other regions continue, and due to resource constraints and weak public health systems, the global risk is assessed as moderate.

AsUfPxH0VWI69WafJFDpvQ.zh: 墨西哥病例資訊更新,該國於4/4報告首例H5N1流感人類感染病例,為該國西北部杜蘭戈州(Durango)3歲女童,病患於4/8因呼吸道併發症死亡,目前相關接觸者檢驗結果皆為陰性,迄無其他人類感染病例,評估傳播風險為低。
AsUfPxH0VWI69WafJFDpvQ.en: Mexico has updated information on human H5N1 infection cases. The country reported its first human H5N1 infection case on 4 April: a 3-year-old girl from Durango State in the northwest, who died on 8 April of respiratory complications. All contact test results are negative, no other human infection cases have been reported, and the risk of transmission is assessed as low.

mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.zh: 越南3/21公布今年迄今共63省市報告4.2萬餘例疑病例,其中逾4,000例確診及5例死亡,以南部(54%)為多,次為中部(20%),多數病例為9個月至15歲以下孩童,占比超過70%,其中超過95%未接種疫苗。目前病例集中於都會地區,惟山區省分病例數呈增加趨勢,目前預期疫情將下降,惟全國各地仍將持續發生病例,尤其是山區及疫苗覆蓋率低之省分。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/25累計報告379例(德州327例/新墨西哥州43例/奧克拉荷馬州9例),其中42例住院,2例死亡,該國公布今年截至3/20已有18州報告378例,其中64例住院。 PAHO於3/24發布美洲地區風險評估,截至3/15共4國報告507例,分別為美國301例(含2例死亡)、加拿大173例、墨西哥22例及阿根廷11例,病例數較去年同期91例上升5.5倍。因病毒於該區持續流行,多數國家疫苗覆蓋率未達95%目標,且新冠疫情期間疫苗接種中斷,疫苗猶豫情形增加及弱勢族群醫療可近性有限等因素,評估整體風險為高,評估信心水準為高。 吉爾吉斯今年迄今報告4,055例,其中,8例兒童死亡,首都比斯凱克、北部楚河州與南部奧什州病例數大幅上升,超過95%病例未接種疫苗;該國去年報告1.4萬餘例及6例死亡,疫情上升主要為疫苗覆蓋率低所致,比斯凱克覆蓋率僅63%。
mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.en: Viet Nam announced on 21 March that 63 provinces and cities have reported over 42,000 suspected cases so far this year, of which over 4,000 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south (54%), followed by the central region (20%). Most cases are children aged from 9 months to under 15 years, accounting for over 70%, and over 95% were unvaccinated. Cases are currently concentrated in urban areas, but numbers are rising in mountainous provinces. Although the outbreak is expected to decline, cases will continue to occur across the country, especially in mountainous areas and provinces with low vaccination coverage. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 25 March, 379 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 327, New Mexico 43, Oklahoma 9), of which 42 were hospitalized and 2 died. The United States reported that as of 20 March, 378 cases had been reported from 18 states, of which 64 were hospitalized. PAHO issued a risk assessment for the Americas on 24 March. As of 15 March, 4 countries had reported 507 cases: the United States 301 (including 2 deaths), Canada 173, Mexico 22 and Argentina 11. This is 5.5 times the 91 cases reported in the same period last year. Because the virus continues to circulate in the region, most countries have not reached the 95% vaccination coverage target, vaccination was disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy has increased and access to healthcare for vulnerable groups is limited, the overall risk is assessed as high, with high confidence. Kyrgyzstan has reported 4,055 cases so far this year, including 8 child deaths. Case numbers have risen sharply in the capital Bishkek, northern Chuy Region and southern Osh Region, and over 95% of cases were unvaccinated. Kyrgyzstan reported over 14,000 cases and 6 deaths last year. The increase is mainly due to low vaccination coverage; coverage in Bishkek is only 63%.

r6FgADjZggwIUNilx63u-A.en: Global update: Last year, up to November, over 14 million cases and 10,000 deaths were reported worldwide. Cases were mainly in the Region of the Americas, which reported over 12.5 million cases and 7,000 deaths, with Brazil reporting over 10 million cases, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and Paraguay. Australia update: Townsville in Queensland State in the northeast reported one case, the city's first locally acquired case in five years.

veNZr8hW2j89cB2g1ptSYA.zh: 2024年第42週(10/14-10/20)全球陽性率約18.9%,陽性率以歐洲區(20.1%)、美洲區(13.5%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 歐洲XEC病例數呈上升趨勢,愛爾蘭最近5週XEC變異株占比約7.1%。 美國主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,另XEC變異株占比持續上升。 墨西哥今年迄今累計13,000例病例,其中638例死亡,病例分布以墨西哥城、克雷塔羅州、新萊昂州及普埃布拉州為多。
veNZr8hW2j89cB2g1ptSYA.en:
Situation update: In week 42 of 2024 (14–20 October), the global positivity rate was about 18.9%, highest in the European Region (20.1%), the Region of the Americas (13.5%) and the African Region (4.4%).

XEC cases are rising in Europe; in Ireland, the XEC variant accounted for about 7.1% over the past 5 weeks.

The main circulating variant in the United States is KP.3.1.1, and the share of XEC variants continues to rise.

Mexico has cumulatively reported 13,000 cases this year, including 638 deaths. Cases are mainly distributed in Mexico City, Querétaro State, Nuevo León State and Puebla State.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.
